title: Fill at 30°: rows counter-clockwise on screen, 1/density apart
description: A 40 × 40 mm fill at 30° (counter-clockwise on screen), under sewing off: the rows run at 30° (the file's y-down angle 150°) and PE-DESIGN's stitch count is matched within 2 %. The corner rows near the start differ (stitch-rules F5).

evidence.note: Fill Stitch: Direction, Density, Step pitch, Frequency

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 40 mm square from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm with the Rectangle tool. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 30°, Under sewing unticked, every other region attribute at PE-DESIGN's default (Density 4.5, Step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Feathered edge and Gradation off). Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).
